verdict_summary: Observability LAYER is GREEN: /api/healthz works, outbox dashboard renders + buttons present, structured logs flowing across 4 channels (fiscal/observability/security/laravel), audit_trail wired end-to-end, all 5 boot guards present in AppServiceProvider. However the SYSTEM being observed has live alerts: 378 stale outbox events + 152 failed jobs + queue:work + websockets:serve marked DOWN — which is exactly what an observability layer is supposed to surface. Verdict GAPS attributed to upstream queue infrastructure not the obs layer itself.
